chapter: On the road, James Brown and the 1956 crash
title: Disbanding in 1959 after eight years on the road
summary: Cobb disbanded in February 1959 after a last job in Philadelphia and confirms he had led his own band for Universal from about 1950 until his 1956 accident.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: I disbanded in 1959, February, and my last job, when I made up my mind I was going to make it back to Houston and disbanded my band was in Philadelphia at the Peps Gapps Bar. I was through with it.
Well, Arnett, let me ask you something. When you got out of the hospital and started again for Universal, what year was that?
So for eight years you were on the road with your own band?
